prerequisites: Requirement of knowledge of the course "Engineering Graphics - Descriptive Geometry"
Requirement of knowledge of the course "Engineering Graphics: Engineering Drawing "
Requirement of handling skills of computer hardware

learning_outcomes.text: Students should be able to build 3D models of machine parts
Students should be able to build 3D models of the machines parts and assemblies and verify models and their parameters
Students should be able to make 2D technical drawing based on a 3D model
Student gains the skills to take responsibility for their work

syllabus_topics: Introduction to solid modeling - basic solid modeling operations, the rules of creation of a 2D sketch, fittings in the sketch (geometric and dimensional fittings)
Basic solid modeling - Advanced operations on 2D sketches, solid modeling with extrude methods
Solid Modeling Basics - operations on solids: chamfering, rounding, tilting walls, constructions (point, axis, plane), the creation of the ribs, the holes wizard, duplication of the solid operations
Basic solid modeling - Advanced operations on 2D sketches - function relationships of parameters, solid modeling with rotation, solid editing - shell models
Basic solid modeling - solid modeling with rotation, one and multibody modeling
Advanced solid operations - sweep, loft, split, scroll
The project of assembly: the concept, the construction of the parts by using the known solid modeling methods
The project of assembly: preparing to create an assembly- parts assembling, bonds and relationships in the assembly
The project of assembly: parts assembling, parts editing in an assembly, a library of standard parts
The project of assembly: parts modeling in the assembly environment, the adaptability of the parts
The project of assembly: analysis of the functional correctness of the assembly (parameters analysis, kinematic analysis, analysis of collision) rectify design faults, loads analysis
The project of assembly: loads analysis, reactions and forces at the nodes, the presentation of the model
The project of assembly: 2D technical drawings of parts - manufacturing parts drawings
The project of assembly: 2D technical drawings of assembly - assembly drawings
Completion of the course: work during classes
teaching_methods: self study - preparation for project class
independent work on the computer under the tutor supervision
assessment_rules: The concluding evaluation (P) is equal to the forming evaluation (F1). F1 is based on a test and participation in problem discussions. Work during classes is also part of the completion.
